templates.source_expression:
f"finding ledger does not balance: {s5_out_count} entered "
           f"verification, {accounted} accounted for in verified/dropped "
           f"({-diff} more than entered — a double-count, not a loss)"

               f"verification, {accounted} accounted for in verified/dropped "

                  f"app_profile={'yes' if app_profile else 'no'}"

                  f"artefacts → {rem_dir}"

f"HEAD moved since scan ({report.git_sha[:8]} → "
                f"{cur[:8]}); pass --force to override"

                     f"reach this URL"

"  [graphdb] hydrated ctx.call_graph from sqlite: "
            f"step={step} nodes={graph['node_count']}"

                      "(expired/invalid credentials or a broken proxy/TLS path)"

                      f"findings ({len(report.dropped)} dropped), "
                      f"{len(report.chains)} chains."
